description: List the starter packs shipped with the lexicon (curated names with the misspellings STT produces for them) and which are already installed. Pass registry (an index the user registered; others are refused) to also list that index's community packs (<author>/<name>), with an installed flag for each. The installed flags come from trusted lexicon files only: when the repo has an untrusted project lexicon, the result carries `projectTrust`, `skippedProject` (its path) and `note`, and a pack only that file records reads as not installed. When a lexicon file's settings.packs and the registry records disagree, `registryMismatch { fileOnly, recordOnly }` names the refs: fileOnly will not be checked by `lexicon pack update` (or `npx @ashlr/lexicon pack update`), recordOnly reads as not installed (`lexicon pack remove <ref>` (or `npx @ashlr/lexicon pack remove <ref>`) clears the record). Call when onboarding a new user or when they ask what packs exist; describe each pack in one line, then call add_pack only for the ones they pick.

registry.description: Registry index for community packs, as the user gave it: only an index the user registered is read (one they installed a pack from with the CLI, or one in LEXICON_REGISTRIES); any other is refused, and so is a blank one. Omit for the vendored starter packs only.

name: list_packs
title: List the starter term packs
